Boiler explosion at Andhra Pradesh pharma factory kills workers

A boiler explosion occurred at a pharmaceutical factory in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, resulting in the deaths of at least four workers and injuring more than ten others. Reports indicate that five employees died and over ten were injured in the incident.
